name: Citizenship by Descent (Birth Outside Myanmar to a Citizen Parent)

requirements.blocker_text: Born to a parent (or combination of parents) who is a citizen, associate citizen, or naturalised citizen of Myanmar, per Section 7's tiered parent-status combinations.
Birth registered within 1 year of the date of birth at a Myanmar Embassy or Consulate (Section 10) -- late registration possible with sufficient justification.
requirements.fix_path: Register the birth at a Myanmar diplomatic mission; late registration may still be possible with adequate justification.

evidence_required.document: Parent's proof of Myanmar citizen/associate/naturalised status

sources.title: UNHCR Refworld -- Burma Citizenship Law, 1982 (English translation), Sections 7 and 10: citizenship extends to persons born outside Myanmar under several parent-status combinations (both parents citizens; one citizen + one associate/naturalised; and further mixed combinations); births outside Myanmar must be registered within 1 year at a Myanmar Embassy or Consulate, with late-registration provision for sufficient justification

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Myanmar). STATUS: DRAFT -- same tier-2-only sourcing limitation as the other Myanmar citizenship files (UNHCR Refworld's hosted translation is the only text of the 1982 law located; no tier-1 Myanmar-government copy found). Section 7's exact combinatorial rules (which pairing of citizen/associate/naturalised parents yields which tier of citizenship for the child) were only partially retrieved in this build -- modeled here at the general level of 'has a qualifying parent', not the precise resulting citizenship tier the child would receive, which the source material describes as varying by the specific parent-status combination. This is DISTINCT from a genuine 1823-ancestry ethnic-descent claim (Section 3's 'national races' framework, which underlies mm_citizenship_naturalisation.json's ethical-context note on Rohingya exclusion) -- this file models ordinary descent from a CURRENT citizen parent, the same mechanism most countries in this dataset use, not the ethnicity-gated foundational category. dual_citizenship_allowed FALSE per Section 16, consistent with the other Myanmar citizenship files.
